notes.content:

Those who want to participate in the competition just need to create one or more video works around "Oh my goodness! If you can't find true love, then you'll be fighting!". Whether it's narrative, humor, analysis, or real-life situations, it's all possible.

notes.title: Bug fix announcement
notes.content:
Oh my goodness! If you can't find your true love, just go to the streets! Bug fix announcement
Dear players
Thank you all for your enthusiastic support and tolerance towards "Oh my goodness! If you can't find true love, just go to the streets!"! We attach great importance to everyone's feedback and have been working hard to improve the gaming experience. In response to the feedback from everyone, the team made overnight repairs. The following are the specific updates:
Repair content:
1. Fix achievement counting bug.
2. Fix the bug in Chapter 4 that cannot be continued.
3. Compatible with lower version graphics card drivers, no longer prompting for graphics card driver updates.
4. Add border window settings, allowing users to adjust window size (suitable for some models).
5. Fix the bug where duplicate achievements are displayed, and fix the issue where three achievements cannot be achieved.
6. Fix the bug of missing skip buttons when reviewing past content.
7. Fixed the issue of unable to switch windows in full screen mode. When the screen adaptation size is stretched, it can be switched to window mode (suitable for some models).
8. Fixed the issue with cloud archiving, it can now be used normally.
9. Fix the issue where the Chinese installation path cannot be used.
Thank you all for providing pictures, videos, and analysis during the bug handling process, which allowed us to quickly identify and solve problems. Currently, with everyone's help, our repair list is gradually being eliminated.
We are well aware that these issues may cause inconvenience to everyone, and once again thank you for your understanding and support. We will continue to work hard to bring you a better gaming experience.
Wishing everyone a pleasant game!
Respected King Interactive Entertainment Team
In addition, we have prepared a questionnaire aimed at collecting everyone's opinions and suggestions on the follow-up content of "Oh my goodness!" and related issues of "Oh my goodness! Girls' Team". We hope to hear your voices in order to provide a better gaming experience for everyone.
Questionnaire address: https://docs.qq.com/form/page/DUGZ5RHVRS0pvT2pw
Thank you all for your participation and support!

notes.title: It's almost online. What are we busy with!
notes.content:
Dear players, [/h3]
The countdown to the release of "Oh my god! If you can't find true love, just go to the streets!" has entered.

Here is a progress report to the players:
Game progress: After more than a month of review, it has been approved and is currently undergoing fine-tuning during testing.
Release arrangement: It will be officially released on May 31st
Exchange and discussion: QQ group: 833671268

Thank you very much for your support and expectations, and I have also gained many insightful suggestions during the previous live broadcast process. Helped us understand many shortcomings of the product. Our positioning for the first film game of "Oh my God" is only a passing work. As newcomers to interactive dramas, we also made many mistakes in the early stages (such as: there are too many, we don't know where to start...). Although we have been making corrections and adjustments throughout the production process, there is still a huge gap between our works and those of other predecessors. We hope to accumulate experience in the parts that have not been adjusted in this work. The future Tianna series products will definitely become better and better.

The original intention of creating interactive products for real people is to hope that everyone can find a relaxed and unique time in their busy lives. They can leave their daily work and study, and have an independent time to experience the blue sky and blue sea, meet their favorite characters, and spend a happy time together. For games, it may seem like a single journey, but for us, interactive games are the beginning of meeting characters, and we also hope that players can establish a sustained and long-term connection with characters in subsequent products, offline performances, and live variety shows.
In addition, regarding the follow-up of the "Oh my God" series, I believe everyone will gradually learn about some ongoing work through various channels. Last weekend, we held a special recruitment event for "Oh my goodness! Girl Group" at Jing'an Joy City in Shanghai, which attracted everyone's attention.
On June 4th, we will continue to conduct a special recruitment for "Oh my God" in Beijing, and Ms. Xu Jingwen, who returned from Haishe Apartment to Beijing, will also attend the event as an on-site judge guest. At that time, it will also be presented to everyone through DY live streaming.

Oh my goodness! If you can't find your true love, then throw yourself into the street! It's our first one, but it won't be the last one. We will definitely do better and continuously present higher quality content to everyone.

[h2] On May 31st, Steam will be together. Wishing everyone a happy time. [/h2]

notes.title: Schedule to log in to the Steam platform on May 31st!
notes.content:
Dear players, [/h3]

We are very excited to announce that "Oh my god! If you can't find your true love, just go to the streets!" will be officially released on the Steam platform on May 31, 2024! As a highly anticipated interactive storyline love game, this game takes you on a journey full of emotional depth and choices.

[img] {STEAL_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934691/e5c0b3a2571beed445dbd917dc4d1c36bb24c99b. png [/img]

[h3] What the production team wants to say: [/h3]
During the production process, we also experienced doubts and difficulties. Sometimes, a seemingly simple plot twist requires repeated revisions to meet our emotional expectations. During this process, I deeply realized the value of facing challenges and sharing achievements with team members. We are not only creating a game, but also experiencing a life journey together, which makes our team relationship closer and fills this game with real emotions and vitality.
Thank you to all the players and team members who have supported us. Without your support and efforts, there would be no such thing as "Oh my god! If you can't find true love, just go to the streets!" today. We look forward to the release of the game, hoping it can touch your heartstrings and become a beautiful memory in your life.
As the game is about to be released, I share this journey with both excitement and nervousness. Every expectation and praise is our greatest support and encouragement. Let's meet on Steam on May 31st and experience this journey of finding true love together.
Thank you again for your company, we will never see each other again!

[h3] Game features: [/h3]
[b] Interactive storyline experience [: [/b] Players will play Huang Di, a young man who has just graduated from college and is facing life choices. By interacting with eight distinct female characters, each of your choices will affect Huang Di's emotional direction and destiny.
[b] Multi ending setting: [/b] The game has multiple parallel time chapters, each chapter will bring different story directions and endings based on your choices, simulating the uncertainty and complexity of love in a realistic way.
[b] High quality audio-visual performance: [/b] Combined with real-life shooting, every scene in the game is lifelike, as if taking players directly into this tropical paradise. While exploring interactive storylines, players can not only experience gripping stories, but also enjoy the picturesque scenery of Hainan, experiencing the unique cultural and natural beauty of the place.
[b] Deep emotional exploration: [/b] Games are not only about the pursuit of romantic love, but also about 

the exploration of human nature, life value, and emotional depth.

[h3] Launch time and platform: [/h3]
[b] Online time: [/b] May 31, 2024
[b] Online platform: [/b] Steam
[b] Game pack size: [/b] Approximately 24GB, ensure your device has enough
